recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered urban portrait featuring a central figure in high-contrast leather attire, set against a split background of solid white and a faded, ghostly secondary portrait. The composition is anchored by aggressive, vertically-oriented custom lettering on the left and a staggered horizontal subtitle on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: High-gloss leather textures contrasting with soft, faded background skin tones
Vertical cyan lettering balancing the central figure's crouching posture
Ghostly facial overlay providing depth and narrative complexity to the flat background
Sharp drop shadows on text creating a 3D pop against the 2D plane
coreInvariants: Crouching central subject in black leather
Vertical text orientation on the left margin
Cyan and black color palette for primary graphics
Faded secondary portrait in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central crouching figure, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space, slightly offset to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-gloss highlights on the leather jacket and boots.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the vertical cyan text, moves to the subject's face, then follows the diagonal of the crouch to the subtitle on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space in the upper left and right, used to isolate the subject and provide clarity for the ghostly overlay.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and light grey background for high-key contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the subject's clothing and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant cyan for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value background with low saturation, contrasted by high-value, high-saturation cyan and low-value black.

letterConstructionRules: Deep black drop shadow offset to the bottom-right
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated descenders and ascenders that interlock or overlap
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive custom display lettering paired with a standard heavy italic sans-serif for legibility.

preserve: Vertical orientation of the main name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and energy of the subtitle.
Approximates the sharp, angular nature of the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a woman in a black leather jacket and boots, crouching. Overlay a faint, low-opacity close-up of her face in the background on the right side. Keep the left side mostly white space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large vertical cyan custom lettering on the far left with a hard black drop shadow. Add a staggered, two-line subtitle in heavy black italic sans-serif on the right side, tilted slightly upwards.

verificationChecks: Is the main text oriented vertically?
Is there a ghostly face overlay in the background?
Is the primary color for text cyan?
Is the subject wearing high-gloss black leather?

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the background face overlay
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact letterforms of the custom display text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cyan text has a distinct hard shadow.
Check that the background overlay does not obscure the main subject.
Verify the vertical text is legible despite its orientation.
Confirm the leather texture appears glossy and reflective.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast fashion portrait with vertical, shadowed display type and a low-opacity background collage element for a 2000s urban aesthetic.
